label: pendant on a backplate (disc, medallion, or shaped plate)
construction: A plate pendant: one solid plate of metal in the specified shape (disc, oval, shield, heart, dog tag) carrying the mark engraved or raised on its face; one bail at the top edge, made from the same metal and joined to the plate; a chain passing through the bail. The mark stays within the plate's edges.
